description: Vendor security review / third-party risk check: a first-pass security and privacy profile of a software vendor from its own public website, given a domain. Answers "is this vendor SOC 2 certified?" and "do they train AI on our data?": certifications it claims (SOC 2 Type I/II, ISO 27001/27701/42001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, FedRAMP…), whether it trains AI models on customer data (with the exact quote and page), subprocessor list, DPA, data residency, security features (SSO/SAML, SCIM, MFA, encryption, pen tests, bug bounty), security.txt contact, status page, links to trust center, privacy policy and terms, plus a 0-100 transparency score. Use for vendor risk assessments, procurement and security questionnaires. Certifications are vendor claims, not verified audits.
name: vendor_trust_profile
title: Vendor security & privacy profile
